# ErgoTask Pro Office Chair

## Overview

The ErgoTask Pro is an inspired office chair designed to deliver exceptional comfort and modern aesthetics for any workspace. Built with a sleek plastic back and front shell, it offers a clean, contemporary look that complements both home offices and corporate environments.

Choose from five stunning base finishes to match your style: **stainless steel**, **matte black**, **gloss white**, or **chrome**.

## Construction

Engineered for durability and smooth mobility, the ErgoTask Pro features a **5-wheel plastic-coated aluminium base** that glides effortlessly across any floor surface while protecting against scratches and scuffs.

## Dimensions

| Measurement | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| **Width** | 53 cm |
| **Depth** | 51 cm |

## Key Features

- Inspired ergonomic design for all-day comfort
- Durable plastic back and front shell
- Premium 5-wheel plastic-coated aluminium base
- Multiple base finish options to suit any decor
- Lightweight yet sturdy construction
